**Note that [Netty 4.1 will be End-of-Life on July 1st, 2027](https://netty.io/news/2026/09/09/4-1-EOL-announcement.html).**

We strongly recommend upgrading to this version to get the following security fixes:

- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-frq3-7pw6-36cg) : parser desync in `io.netty:netty-codec-haproxy`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-6g26-xhvx-g5w3) : improper CRLF neutralization (request/response smuggling) in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x9f7-rg73-4rp6) : origin validation error in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-2p3h-phr9-jf38) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http2`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-vwgc-hvc9-2j59) : request/response smuggling in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-m3w2-2657-46g8) : time-of-check/time-of-use error in `io.netty:netty-handler-ssl-ocsp`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-jp47-57pp-4qpp) : SNI routing bypass in `io.netty:netty-handler`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-35qr-v9mm-35c5) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-xml`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-5h6f-wp3f-6hmv) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-base`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x436-m93c-g2q9) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-c7hc-m259-xhcr) : input misinterpretation in `io.netty:netty-codec-socks`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-268p-9r42-7qp4) : improper access control in `io.netty:netty-handler`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-3h79-3wcf-5whr) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-dns`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-25w5-4jgp-m94q) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http3`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x2j7-6j3j-5vwj) : use-after-free in `io.netty:netty-transport-classes-io_uring`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-79q2-mhf4-2j6j) : memory leak in `io.netty:netty-transport-native-io_uring`

Note that due to overwhelming strain on the CVE infrastructure, we have not gotten a single CVE number assigned to these reports in time for our release.
The advisories will be published without.

Specific changes worth calling out:

**Validation in `FileUpload.setContentType`.**
Previously, the `FileUpload.setContentType` methods did not validate their inputs.
They now throw an `IllegaalArgumentException` if the given string is not formatted as a plausible MIME content type.

## What's Changed
* perf: Use LinkedHashSet to deduplicate search domains by @JunggiKim in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17400
* Handle non-positive skip lengths in ByteBufInputStream by @cuishuang in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17388
* Avoid double promise allocation in SslHandler.wrap() by @doom369 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17382
* Socket: Add half-closure tests to SocketHalfClosedTest by @rajan-github in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17394
* HttpUtil.getCharset() must accept whitespace before the next Content-Type parameter by @hunseonglee in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17386
* codec-dns: Add SMIMEA, CDS, CDNSKEY, OPENPGPKEY, CSYNC, ZONEMD records by @hyperxpro in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17373
* transport: Avoid io_uring completion callback allocation by @massiccio in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17457
* QUIC: Ensure writable events reflect stream capacity by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17431
* OcspServerCertificateValidatorTest: Fix possible leak in test by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17469
* Use github to download cmake and also remove tar file after unpacking by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17482
* build: Upgrade GitHub Actions to fix Node.js 20 deprecation warnings by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17484
* HttpUtil.getMimeType() must not include whitespace before the next Content-Type parameter by @ohchanKyu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17456
* Fix buffer leak when recvmmsg returns single UDP_GRO batch by @octa-one in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17493
* Guard ChunkedWriteHandler.doFlush() against re-entrant invocation from user code by @fudianchn in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17438
* Add regression test for close() cascade reentering flush() by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17497
* Fix UDP_GRO segment size is lost when reading with recvmmsg by @octa-one in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17492
* KQueueDatagramChannel: rewrite IPv4-wildcard bind to IPv6-any on dual-stack sockets by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17498
* Make CompositeBufferGatheringWriteTest robust against write/close race by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17508
* Add option to ignore MaxDirectMemorySize JVM argument by @franz1981 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17177
* Only build affected Maven modules for PR verification by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17512
* Add workflow that will cancel running workflows for merged PRs by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17518
* Harden DnsNameResolverTest against transient null localAddress from TestDnsServer by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17514
* Fix flaky memory leak detection in OcspServerCertificateValidatorTest by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17524
* Cache docker build images in ghcr.io to speed up CI by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17530
* HTTP/2: Remove failed SETTINGS from ACK queue by @Gimini-3 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17387
* Fix compilation on latest macOS 27.0 by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17529
* Make `IoEventLoopGroup.isCompatible/isIoType` side-effect free by @idelpivnitskiy in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17544
* Fix flaky memory leak detection in OcspServerCertificateValidatorTest by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17536
* Reset busy counters after triggering an auto-scale-up decision by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17538
* Http2ConnectionRoundtripTest: Reduce timing sensitivity to fix CI flakiness by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17540
* ProtobufVarint32FrameDecoder must wait for more data when the length prefix is incomplete by @ohchanKyu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17550
* QpackEncoder.sectionAcknowledgment must not NPE when dynamic table is disabled by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17537
* Fix missing readable-bytes check in SmtpResponseDecoder by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17516
* Guard against out-of-bounds reads when parsing ClientHello SNI extension by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17532
* Fix IndexOutOfBoundsException from mismatched varint length in Http3FrameCodec by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17523
* Fix missing readable-bytes checks in QuicHeaderParser by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17515
* Http2: Reserve promised stream before running the request verifier by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17495
* Fix HTTP/3 decoding of frames with zero length payloads by @violetagg in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17564
* DnsAddressResolverGroupTest: Use a mock DNS server instead of resolving netty.io over the network by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17566
* Use random generated LocalAddress in tests that use local transport by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17570
* POOL: Release Channel when SimpleChannelPool acquire is cancelled by @renechoi in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17569
* Fix missing per-entry clamp in IoUringBufferRing.useBuffer by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17568
* Reject incomplete PUSH_PROMISE request headers when validateRequiredPseudoHeaders is enabled by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17460
* Add regression tests for CANCEL_PUSH/GOAWAY/MAX_PUSH_ID trailing bytes by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17571
* Use 2 EventLoops when running our tests by default by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17567
* Fix flaky HttpToHttp2ConnectionHandlerTest.testChunkedRequestWithBodyAndTrailingHeaders by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17590
* Http2ConnectionHandler: report at most one stream error for a CompositeStreamException by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17470
* Http2MultiplexTransportTest: Fix possible SslContext leak in tests by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17597
* Restore configurable ioRatio-based task scheduling in SingleThreadIoEventLoop by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17481
* Support creating a PropertyKey that is not tied to a specific Http2Connection by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17594
* Reset LengthFieldBasedFrameDecoder state when the frame is shorter than initialBytesToStrip by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17606
* Auto-port 4.2: SingleThreadEventExecutor: fix race between suspend and cancellation … by @netty-project-bot in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17601
* Fix `ByteBuf.setBytes(int, ByteBuffer)` when the source is the buffer's own internal NIO buffer by @laosijikaichele in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17618
* Add missing bounds check to `AdaptiveByteBuf.getBytes(...)` channel variants by @laosijikaichele in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17620
* SingleThreadEventExecutor: fix remaining suspend/cancellation race by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17627
* Update lz4-java to 1.12.0 by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17631
* Fix connection error scope for SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE overflow issue by @skyguard1 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17602
* HTTP/2: Fix stream stall when toggling auto-read on a child channel by @pandareen in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17617
* Run the Linux test legs on ubuntu-24.04 so io_uring buffer ring tests execute by @franz1981 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17637
* Update quiche to a new version 0.30.0 by @sanjomo in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17642
* No need to call `clear()` on `ByteBuffer` after `AdaptiveByteBuf.internalNioBuffer()` by @laosijikaichele in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17619
* Don't strand tasks when trySuspend() races with startThread() by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17608
* Use assertInstanceOf/assertThrows instead of assertTrue/fail idioms in tests by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17633
* PendingWriteQueue: unlink the write before failing it in removeAndFail by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17657
* Don't lose HashedWheelTimer timeouts that race with stop() by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17610
* Don't corrupt the pipeline when a handler context is removed twice by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17643
* LocalChannel: complete connect() when the accepted channel dies before registration by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17656
* Don't leak FixedChannelPool slots on unrelated IllegalArgumentException by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17609
* Don't leak queued writes in ChunkedWriteHandler on removal or cancel by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17663
* Honour the needle's reader index in ByteBufUtil.indexOf(ByteBuf, ByteBuf) by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17682
* Close idle outbound HTTP/2 child channels when the parent closes by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17679
* Only fail in ZlibDecoder when the decompression buffer is full by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17692
* Fail pending writes of ProxyHandler when it is removed by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17691
* Use LocalIoHandler instead of DefaultEventLoop for LocalChannel tests in codec-http2 by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17697
* Arm force-close timeout when an inbound CLOSE frame is echoed by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17574
* Don't count STOMP headers again when the header block is replayed by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17664
* Add script that allows to check if a user has signed the icla by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17711
* Complete HTTP/2 graceful close when the connection closes the last stream by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17683
* Handle ed25519 and ed448 names in SignatureAlgorithmConverter by @eager-signal in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17689
* MqttDecoder accepts malformed MQTT 5 property sections and reclassifies payload bytes as properties by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17714

* Validate bzip2 Huffman table selector index before use by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17705
* Reset the permessage-deflate compressor after an empty final fragment by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17681

* Fix racy DnsNameResolverTest.testNegativeTtl lifecycle observer checks by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17737
* Fix retainedSlice() of non-retained pooled derived buffers by @lhotari in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17759
* Build using powershell on Windows by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17766

## Compatibility Notes
A number of security fixes have added additional validation and impose new resource usage limits, which may cause existing workloads to fail or be rejected. We recommend that you test your systems thoroughly as part of your Netty upgrade.

Two specific changes are worth calling out:

**QUIC now explicitly requires `X509ExtendedTrustManager` when hostname verification is enabled.**
Previously, when configuring QUIC with an endpoint identification algorithm and an `X509TrustManager`, hostname verification would be silently skipped.
This is now considered a misconfiguration and an exception will be thrown.

**HTTP/2 header _value_ validation is now enabled by default.**
HTTP/2 header _name_ validation has always been enabled by default, with an option to disable it, but HTTP/2 header _value_ validation has been disabled by default until now. Configuration options still exist to disable this, but validation of HTTP header names and values are now both opt-in by default rather than opt-out.

## Compatibility note

**HTTP/2 header _value_ validation is now enabled by default.**
HTTP/2 header _name_ validation has always been enabled by default, with an option to disable it, but HTTP/2 header _value_ validation has been disabled by default until now.
Configuration options still exist to disable this, but validation of HTTP header names and values are now both opt-in by default rather than opt-out.

## What's Changed
* Auto-port 4.1: MQTT: Allow MQTT 5 CONNECT with password only by @netty-project-bot in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16834
* ChannelInitializer: correct misleading comment on exceptionCaught route by @daguimu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16847
* HTTP/2: Parse request-target path like Vert.x (4.1 backport) by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16856
* HttpObjectDecoder skips arbitrary initial control characters when only initial CRLF characters are permitted by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16861
* IpSubnetFilter: Correctly handle ipv6 by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16860
* Configurable bound on RedisArrayAggregator by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16858
* Redis: Limit decoded length by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16859
* DNS: Ensure query id is not predictible by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16870
* Wrapping plain trust manager silently disables hostname verification by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16868
* MQTT: Reject malformed no-payload packets with non-zero Remaining Length by @daguimu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16852
* Fix revapi warnings (#16885) by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16892
* HAProxy: Reject HAProxyMessages with malformated TLV and not leak memory by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16866
* SSL: Use sane defaults as limits for the client hello length and timeout by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16871
* DNS: Only cache CNAME if part of the queried domain by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16873
* HTTP/2: Enforce max concurrent streams for misbehaving clients by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16876
* Dns: Insufficient Bailiwick Validation for NS Records by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16877
* HTTP2: DelegatingDecompressorFrameListener must release memory in all cases by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16880
* Pass maxAllocation to Brotli and Zstd decoders (#16844) by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16886
* HTTP/2: Treat clients MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE as advisory by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16883
* Auto-port 4.1: Add maxWindowLog parameter to ZstdDecoder to bound memory allocation by @netty-project-bot in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16894
* HAProxy: Fix ByteBuf leak when parsing nested SSL TLVs by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16881
* Epoll / Kqueue: Correctly handle receive of FD by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16872
* SCTP: Limit the number of inflight incomplete SCTP messages and the number of fragments by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16875

* Redis: Limit the maximum number of nested arrays by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16882

* Quic: Ensure writes are done before notify close promise of QuicheQui… by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16758
* Avoid re-parsing openssl key material with non-cached provider by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16759
* Pin HTTP/RTSP version + method normalization to Locale.US by @daguimu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16765

* Auto-port 4.2: Make bulk byte moving in ByteBuf faster by @netty-project-bot in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16781
* Pin multipart Content-Type / Content-Transfer-Encoding case folding to Locale.US by @daguimu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16768
* Remove dead native declarations by @pandareen in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16783
* Isolate tests that modify available Security providers by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16793
* Remove test annotations from a method that isn't a test by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16792
* Enable OpenSslCachingKeyMaterialProvider to evict stale entries after cert rotation by @zhangweikop in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16523
* IoUring: extend user data from short to long by @dreamlike-ocean in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16682
* Revert CompositeByteBuf component search fast path by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16811

* IpFilter: Fix ClassCastException caused by IpSubnetFilter if only ipv6 rules are configured but remote peer is using ipv4 by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16803
* Fix memoryAddress() for direct ByteBuffers wrapped by Unpooled without Unsafe by @dreamlike-ocean in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16788
* Route synchronous onLookupComplete exceptions via fireExceptionCaught by @kwondh5217 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16794
* IoUring: Stop generic FileRegion drain loop when transferred() reaches count() by @LuciferYang in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/16826

## Breaking Changes

[The patch](https://github.com/netty/netty/commit/84530fa81e12dcd1d42310bb20c1385cb44128d8) for [CVE-2026-42581](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-xxqh-mfjm-7mv9) prohibits HTTP/1.1 requests containing both the `Transfer-Encoding` and `Content-Length` headers, in line with RFC 9112. Previous versions of HTTP/1.1 (RFC 7230) permitted this combination. You can restore the old behavior with the `-Dio.netty.handler.codec.http.rfc9112TransferEncoding=false` system property or with `HttpDecoderConfig`. Note that disabling this check may lead to request smuggling vulnerabilities.

**Note that [Netty 4.1 will be End-of-Life on July 1st, 2027](https://netty.io/news/2026/09/09/4-1-EOL-announcement.html).**

We strongly recommend upgrading to this version to get the following security fixes:

- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-frq3-7pw6-36cg) : parser desync in `io.netty:netty-codec-haproxy`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-6g26-xhvx-g5w3) : improper CRLF neutralization (request/response smuggling) in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x9f7-rg73-4rp6) : origin validation error in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-2p3h-phr9-jf38) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http2`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-vwgc-hvc9-2j59) : request/response smuggling in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-m3w2-2657-46g8) : time-of-check/time-of-use error in `io.netty:netty-handler-ssl-ocsp`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-jp47-57pp-4qpp) : SNI routing bypass in `io.netty:netty-handler`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-35qr-v9mm-35c5) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-xml`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-5h6f-wp3f-6hmv) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-base`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x436-m93c-g2q9) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-c7hc-m259-xhcr) : input misinterpretation in `io.netty:netty-codec-socks`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-268p-9r42-7qp4) : improper access control in `io.netty:netty-handler`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-3h79-3wcf-5whr) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-dns`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-25w5-4jgp-m94q) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http3`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x2j7-6j3j-5vwj) : use-after-free in `io.netty:netty-transport-classes-io_uring`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-79q2-mhf4-2j6j) : memory leak in `io.netty:netty-transport-native-io_uring`

Note that due to overwhelming strain on the CVE infrastructure, we have not gotten a single CVE number assigned to these reports in time for our release.
The advisories will be published without.

Specific changes worth calling out:

**Validation in `FileUpload.setContentType`.**
Previously, the `FileUpload.setContentType` methods did not validate their inputs.
They now throw an `IllegaalArgumentException` if the given string is not formatted as a plausible MIME content type.

## What's Changed
* perf: Use LinkedHashSet to deduplicate search domains by @JunggiKim in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17400

* HttpUtil.getCharset() must accept whitespace before the next Content-Type parameter by @hunseonglee in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17386
* codec-dns: Add SMIMEA, CDS, CDNSKEY, OPENPGPKEY, CSYNC, ZONEMD records by @hyperxpro in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17373

* Guard ChunkedWriteHandler.doFlush() against re-entrant invocation from user code by @fudianchn in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17438

* KQueueDatagramChannel: rewrite IPv4-wildcard bind to IPv6-any on dual-stack sockets by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17498
* Make CompositeBufferGatheringWriteTest robust against write/close race by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17508

* Fix flaky memory leak detection in OcspServerCertificateValidatorTest by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17536
* Reset busy counters after triggering an auto-scale-up decision by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17538

* ProtobufVarint32FrameDecoder must wait for more data when the length prefix is incomplete by @ohchanKyu in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17550

* Guard against out-of-bounds reads when parsing ClientHello SNI extension by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17532

* Fix missing readable-bytes checks in QuicHeaderParser by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17515
* Http2: Reserve promised stream before running the request verifier by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17495

Security

**Note that [Netty 4.1 will be End-of-Life on July 1st, 2027](https://netty.io/news/2026/09/09/4-1-EOL-announcement.html).**

We strongly recommend upgrading to this version to get the following security fixes:

- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-frq3-7pw6-36cg) : parser desync in `io.netty:netty-codec-haproxy`

- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x9f7-rg73-4rp6) : origin validation error in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-2p3h-phr9-jf38) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http2`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-vwgc-hvc9-2j59) : request/response smuggling in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-m3w2-2657-46g8) : time-of-check/time-of-use error in `io.netty:netty-handler-ssl-ocsp`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-jp47-57pp-4qpp) : SNI routing bypass in `io.netty:netty-handler`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-35qr-v9mm-35c5) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-xml`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-5h6f-wp3f-6hmv) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-base`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-x436-m93c-g2q9) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-http`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-c7hc-m259-xhcr) : input misinterpretation in `io.netty:netty-codec-socks`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-268p-9r42-7qp4) : improper access control in `io.netty:netty-handler`
- [CVE-2026-XXXXX](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-3h79-3wcf-5whr) : unbounded resource consumption in `io.netty:netty-codec-dns`

Note that due to overwhelming strain on the CVE infrastructure, we have not gotten a single CVE number assigned to these reports in time for our release.
The advisories will be published without.

Specific changes worth calling out:

**Validation in `FileUpload.setContentType`.**
Previously, the `FileUpload.setContentType` methods did not validate their inputs.
They now throw an `IllegaalArgumentException` if the given string is not formatted as a plausible MIME content type.

## Compatibility Notes
A number of security fixes have added additional validation and impose new resource usage limits, which may cause existing workloads to fail or be rejected. We recommend that you test your systems thoroughly as part of your Netty upgrade.

Two specific changes are worth calling out:

**QUIC now explicitly requires `X509ExtendedTrustManager` when hostname verification is enabled.**
Previously, when configuring QUIC with an endpoint identification algorithm and an `X509TrustManager`, hostname verification would be silently skipped.
This is now considered a misconfiguration and an exception will be thrown.

**HTTP/2 header _value_ validation is now enabled by default.**
HTTP/2 header _name_ validation has always been enabled by default, with an option to disable it, but HTTP/2 header _value_ validation has been disabled by default until now. Configuration options still exist to disable this, but validation of HTTP header names and values are now both opt-in by default rather than opt-out.

## Compatibility note

**HTTP/2 header _value_ validation is now enabled by default.**
HTTP/2 header _name_ validation has always been enabled by default, with an option to disable it, but HTTP/2 header _value_ validation has been disabled by default until now.
Configuration options still exist to disable this, but validation of HTTP header names and values are now both opt-in by default rather than opt-out.

## Breaking Changes

[The patch](https://github.com/netty/netty/commit/84530fa81e12dcd1d42310bb20c1385cb44128d8) for [CVE-2026-42581](https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-xxqh-mfjm-7mv9) prohibits HTTP/1.1 requests containing both the `Transfer-Encoding` and `Content-Length` headers, in line with RFC 9112. Previous versions of HTTP/1.1 (RFC 7230) permitted this combination. You can restore the old behavior with the `-Dio.netty.handler.codec.http.rfc9112TransferEncoding=false` system property or with `HttpDecoderConfig`. Note that disabling this check may lead to request smuggling vulnerabilities.
